methodology: For each of eight pre-authored scenarios, fresh isolated agents received the same raw task. The baseline received no skill; the treatment was explicitly supplied SKILL.md. Outputs were relabelled A/B with alternating assignment and independently scored by two fresh judges against the pre-authored criteria. Per-scenario scores are the mean of both judges.
limitations: The scenarios are synthetic, although designed around realistic product acceptance risks.
Both judges were from the same model family as the candidates.
